summary: ITERATION 19 — Max Lord end-game verification. Backend 10/10 live tests PASS against the preview URL for max.lord@idle1.app (profile domain.owned=100, campaign.highest_cleared=200; GET /battle/stage/200 required_power=739513; POST /battle/attempt {stage:200}.win=true; time-shift +120s + /battle/claim {attempt_id}=win true; POST /army/recruit demon x10 → 200 or 409 queue_full (background 250-bot load simulator was racing on the queue, expected behaviour); /forge/upgrade weapon → 409 forge_max; /research/start economy.crop_yield → 400 max_level; /kingdom/upgrade farm → 400 max_level; /quests daily.templates forge_upgrade.alt_active=true AND start_or_finish_research.alt_active=true; POST /alliances → 200 (created 'Maximus Guard' [MAX] open) and GET /wars/map → 200). Frontend (390x844) all end-game flows verified: Battle tab renders with Lord LV 100, Potenza 1.67M, lord-hp-bar + chat-dock present, Stage 200 · BOSS auto-battling with huge army (angels/demons/dragons visible, floating damage numbers, SUPER banner), no red screen and 0 pageerror. Kingdom tab renders. Formation (/army/formation) shows POTENZA ESERCITO (vs stage) 1.62M, Comando 9050/9050, next stage 201 · END OF REALMS; suggest-formation-button → suggestion-panel + apply-suggestion-button work end-to-end (post-apply Comando 9050/9050 · Potenza 1.69M · toast 'Formazione schierata'). Research screen shows all Economia/Costruzione/Militare/... nodes at 5/5 · 'Massimo' with no 'Potenzia' errors. Hero gear shows +20 on Arma/Stivali/Anello (Lv 100). Talents screen has NO NaN%. /events/quests renders both alternative texts 'Riforgia o smantella oggetti (Forgia al massimo su tutti gli slot) · alternativa' and 'Recluta unità (Ricerca ed edifici al massimo) · alternativa'. Achievements list renders Italian titles and 163/320 Rubini progress. Domain tab shows 100/100 TESSERE without crash. Shop renders and 'Sartoria Reale' + Daily Deal + skin cards visible; skin preview cards render. All checks green.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking RN Web deprecation warnings still present across screens (previously reported in iteration_18).

action_items: (Optional, non-blocking) Address RN Web deprecation warnings across the app (props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents, Image style.tintColor → props.tintColor, textShadow*/shadow* → textShadow/boxShadow).

(Optional) The background 250-bot load simulator can fill the max.lord recruit queue causing sporadic 409 queue_full on /army/recruit; test accommodates this by time-shifting first. No production code change required.
critical_code_review_comments: Battle claim endpoint requires attempt_id in the request body (422 otherwise). The attempt_id is exposed as attempt.id in the /battle/attempt response — the review request originally implied claim without payload; confirmed the frontend claim call must always echo attempt.id.

Alliance 'Maximus Guard' [MAX] created/joined via /alliances (idempotent per review request). Battle attempt+claim on stage 200 was executed which is expected to farm rewards for the account.
